name: Pine forest
desc: Getting lost, being followed, a long walk that goes wrong - cover in every direction and no sightline further than the next trunk.
tags: scenery, no humans, dense pine forest, moss covered trunks, ferns, low fog, fallen log, dirt path, pine needles on ground, shafts of light through canopy
prose: a dense pine forest with moss-covered trunks and ferns underfoot, low fog drifting between the trees, a fallen log across a dirt path and shafts of light falling through the canopy
note: Thins out to three decorative trees on a lawn the moment the tag list gets short - trunk density, undergrowth and the fog all have to stay named. The ground layer (needles, ferns, the fallen log) is what makes it a forest rather than a backdrop of trees. Do not try to darken it with words; reach for the cold or overcast grade instead.
